title: turbo builds with its cache under the run's scratch, and a read-only file system blocks the item instead of asking for a new head
description: A pnpm + turbo workspace whose checkout root is read-only builds in the merge trial: turbo's cache goes under the trial's own scratch (TURBO_CACHE_DIR, which worker verification and the serve pass also set), and no .turbo directory appears in the checkout. A build step failing with 'Read-only file system' records one blocker naming the path, is not retried, and leaves the item unreworked. Fetches pnpm and turbo from the registry on the first run.

steps.name: a read-only checkout root builds with turbo's cache in scratch; a read-only build failure blocks the item once
